newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firmer in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firmer in listless trade.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended slightly firmer after hovering within a tight band in thin trade on Thursday.
A lack of fresh leads and the market's repeated failure to test the 21,300-points resistance level dampened interest, dealers said.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract closed 25 points higher at 21,085 on meagre turnover of 12,200 lots.
"I think the market may make one more attempt to try and break 21,300 but that seems to be a strong resistance area," said a chartist with a local institution.
He said the December Nikkei could consolidate for a move up if it managed to remain between 20,970 and 21,300 over the next few days.
"On the longer-term outlook, there's more downside potential," he said, adding that the market would find support at 20,920 and 20,770.
An eagerly awaited speech by the Japanese Finance Ministry's Eisuke Sakakibara at 0830 GMT could provide direction to the market when it reopens on Friday, dealers said.
One trader said spread activity for the rollover to the March contract had started to come into effect earlier than normal.
